relationships.subject: Phenoxyanilide analogues
relationships.evidence_quote: their low CNS MPO scores and high lipophilicity were indicative of a reduced likelihood of crossing the blood-brain barrier (BBB)

key_findings: Steric and hydrophobic interactions enhanced affinity for CaV2.2 while an electron-rich phenoxy ring favoured CaV3.2 inhibition
CF3 phenoxyanilides were potent at CaV2.2 but likely poorly BBB-penetrant
